messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] GeoDNS resolver probe failures detected in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-15T09:00:34Z — increased DNS latency and intermittent NXDOMAIN responses observed. Pager: oncall-sre.
sara: saw a spike in 5xx for /v1/generate from EU customers ~09:58Z, correlates with DNS failures. filing here so oncall gets context.
eli: I'm on it, grabbing the geodns runbook https://internal/runbooks/geodns-failover and starting probes.
matt: initial dig from my laptop shows inconsistent answers between Cloudflare and Route53 authoritative sets. CF returning stale A records in some POPs.
aj: can confirm — Cloudflare answers include old IPs for a subset of queries, Route53 is returning the expected new set.
sara: customer impact: partial — ~5-7% of EU inference requests failing, some errors are timeouts causing retries and higher tail latency.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-12. Severity: P1. Oncall: eli. Conference bridge: https://meet.link/INC-20260315-12
eli: creating probe script to compare answer sets across public resolvers and our authoritative endpoints
eli: probe snippet:
```
for r in 1.1.1.1 8.8.8.8 9.9.9.9 54.230.0.1; do echo "@${r}"; dig +short @${r} api.redwood-inference.com A; done
```
eli: first run: 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare) returned ip-set A-old in eu-pop, 8.8.8.8 returned A-new, our route53 authoritative returned A-new. TTLs reported low (60s) but some caches appear sticky.
matt: possibility: Cloudflare anycast partition or cache divergence. Also seen increased query volume to CF edges from our health checks.
aj: mitigation idea: shift GeoDNS answers for eu-west to a proxy pool that sources Route53-canonical IPs (bypass CF edge caches) until CF fixes cache divergence.
sara: what's the risk of doing that cutover mid-incident? need a rollback plan and watch windows.
eli: low risk if we set short TTL (60s) and monitor closely. rollback = restore previous rrset and wait TTL. I'll prepare commands.
ops-rotations: note: eli will hand to sara at the 11:15Z oncall rotation slot — plan a controlled handover.
sara: taking ownership now. I'll coordinate with Cloudflare contacts and CS. @customer-success-bot please update status page to warn EU customers.
customer-success-bot: Status page updated: Partial outage affecting EU inference endpoints. Mitigation in progress. Link: https://status.redwood.com/inc/INC-20260315-12
matt: opening CF support ticket with dig traces and probe logs. Also enabling conservative throttling on fallback proxy to avoid overload.
aj: applying GeoDNS change now — switching eu-west to proxy pool that returns route53-backed IPs. TTL set to 60 on new rrset.
eli: monitoring metrics: error rate dropped from 6.1% -> 1.3% over 5m after change. Latency trending down.
sara: CS update: 80% of affected customers reporting recovery. two smaller accounts still seeing timeouts; support tickets created.
customer-success-bot: Notified affected customers: cust-phi, cust-arc. Created support tickets #CS-774, #CS-775.
matt: Cloudflare response: investigating cache divergence in eu-pop cluster; assigned ticket CF-98765. Estimated time-to-fix 30-45m.
eli: continuing to run probe every 60s and logging to /var/log/geodns-probe.log. Will capture dig +trace for mismatched answers.
sara: holding GeoDNS cut at current proxy for now. If CF confirms fix, we'll plan revert ±5m after they confirm global cache flush.
aj: adding guardrails: automated rollback command ready, and I set up a canary in eu-north to test before global revert.
ops-rotations: reminder for next handoff: include CF ticket, probe logs, and the dig sample set in runbook.
eli: handover note for sara: commands used:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123 --change-batch file://geodns-swap.json
# to rollback, apply geodns-rollback.json
```
sara: assigning postmortem owners: eli (detection/telemetry) + matt (third-party coordination) + aj (runbook/automation). Target: draft in 48h.
aj: followups: (1) Add proactive monitor to detect authoritative answer divergence across CF/Route53 within 1m. (2) Add an automated failover to route53-proxy pool when divergence > 0.5% for 3m.
matt: will attach CF ticket updates to the incident and continue to push for cache flush metrics.
sara: marking incident as mitigated at 11:42Z; moving to monitoring. Will reconvene if error rate creeps.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-12 status changed to Monitoring. Pages closed. :white_check_mark:
eli: leaving final note: collected all dig traces to s3://incidents/INC-20260315-12/dig-traces.tar.gz.
sara: thanks team — nice quick mitigation. please keep the action items on the incident doc for postmortem.
customer-success-bot: Post-incident customer update queued; will send once postmortem draft available.
incident-bot: closing incident thread for now. If CF confirms global fix and we revert, add an update here.
